approved.en: Russian forces continued air strikes across Ukraine, killing civilians in Kyiv and other locations, while also targeting Ukrainian data centres to degrade AI capabilities and striking energy facilities, causing multiple deaths and injuries. Ukraine reported a new cruise missile named Filin and said Russian units were infiltrating rear areas near Kupiansk and Khartiia using gas pipelines, while hackers linked to Russia employed a decentralised network in cyberattacks against Ukrainian targets. Kyiv announced a reduction in reliance on Chinese drones despite remaining capability gaps, and Ukraine struck a Russian electronic warfare station. The conflict caused 75,767 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

approved.en: Israeli airstrikes have hit a building in Nuseirat, killing civilians, while attacks on West Bank olive farmers have escalated, with Israeli forces killing two gunmen in a Hebron clash. Netanyahu has ordered a very extensive operation and a lockdown of the West Bank after two Israeli soldiers were killed by suspected Palestinian gunmen at a checkpoint. The Israeli government also announced a closure of the West Bank following the shooting that wounded five Israelis. These steps expand the scope of Israeli military actions beyond previous raids and farmer attacks. The conflict produced 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Netanyahu har beordret en svært omfattende operasjon og en nedstengning av Vestbredden etter at to israelske soldater ble drept av mistenkte palestinske væpnede ved en kontrollpost. Den israelske regjeringen kunngjorde også en stenging av Vestbredden etter skytingen som såret fem israelere. Disse tiltakene utvider omfanget av israelske militære handlinger utover tidligere raid og angrep på bønder. Konflikten førte til 21 440 dødsfall knyttet til kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Hezbollah explosives seized from two Lebanese trucks have led Lebanon's prime minister and security forces to promise a thorough investigation while Israeli artillery and air strikes continue against Hezbollah positions in southern Lebanon, causing civilian casualties. In northern Israel a Hezbollah submunition exploded in a teenager's backpack, killing Elazar Yair Wilensky and wounding dozens, prompting an IDF probe and possible hike restrictions. Qatar has pledged funding for reconstruction in southern Lebanon, announced a massive solar plant project, and its foreign minister called for Israeli withdrawal from Lebanon. The UCDP recorded 4,335 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

I Nord-Israel eksploderte en Hezbollah-submunisjon i en tenårings ryggsekk, og drepte Elazar Yair Wilensky og såret dusinvis, noe som har ført til en IDF-undersøkelse og mulige restriksjoner på høyde. Qatar har lovet finansiering til gjenoppbygging i Sør-Libanon, kunngjort et massivt solkraftprosjekt, og utenriksministeren oppfordret til israelsk tilbaketrekning fra Libanon. approved.en: Iran has warned it will strike oil and AI facilities across the Gulf if attacks resume, and says seven ships were hit in the Hormuz Strait while threatening wider strikes on economic and civilian targets. US personnel were ordered to leave Saudi Arabia and diplomats were advised to depart after missiles struck King Fahd airport, killing one person and wounding eight. Lavrov visited Tehran and publicly backed Iran, hinting at possible Russian involvement. US and Israel are drafting plans for renewed strikes on Iran after the US midterm elections. 123 battle-related deaths occurred in 2024, according to UCDP.

USAs personell ble beordret til å forlate Saudi-Arabia og diplomater ble rådet til å dra etter at missiler traff King Fahd-flyplassen, hvor én person ble drept og åtte såret. Lavrov besøkte Teheran og støttet offentlig Iran, og antydet mulig russisk involvering. USA og Israel utarbeider planer for nye angrep mot Iran etter de amerikanske midtveisvalgene. 123 dødsfall knyttet til kamper ble registrert i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

A Houthi strike on Dammam airport killed two people and injured eight. All 14 Indians aboard a yacht off the Yemen coast were reported safe. The coalition also repelled a wave of overnight attacks on Saudi targets. The conflict caused 918 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Et houthi-angrep på Dammam flyplass drepte to personer og såret åtte. Alle de 14 indere ombord på en yacht utenfor Jemen-kysten ble rapportert trygge. Koalisjonen avverget også en bølge av overnattende angrep på saudiske mål. Konflikten forårsaket 918 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Israeli forces fired across the border into southern Syria, killing a Syrian man with disabilities in the Daraa buffer zone and deploying rooftop snipers who opened fire in the south. Syrian security officers were killed in a raid on an ISIL cell near Damascus. In a separate operation, Syrian forces targeted an ISIS cell in Rankous, resulting in the deaths of two Syrian security personnel. The conflict continued to involve cross-border Israeli strikes and Syrian government counter-terror actions. The war caused 2,732 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Syriske sikkerhetsoffiserer ble drept i et raid på en ISIL-celle nær Damaskus. I en separat operasjon målrettet syriske styrker en IS-celle i Rankous, noe som førte til at to syriske sikkerhetspersonell ble drept. Konflikten fortsatte med grenseoverskridende israelske angrep og syriske regjerings-antiterror-aksjoner. Krigen forårsaket 2 732 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: France is negotiating a new defence agreement with Iraq that would extend to the Kurdistan Region, while Iran is accused of deliberately undermining Iraq's security. Iraqi intelligence helped the UAE seize 200,000 Captagon pills in a joint operation and the Iraqi government has suspended operations at the Al-Shib border crossing with Iran. ISIS claimed responsibility for an explosion that killed an Iraqi Brigadier General and his aide, and the KRG denied reports of Ukrainian drones and personnel in the region. The Iraqi foreign minister met the International Crisis Group president to discuss security developments, and 396 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.

Iraks etterretning hjalp De forente arabiske emirater med å beslaglegge 200 000 Captagon-piller i en felles operasjon, og den irakiske regjeringen har stanset driften ved grenseovergangen Al-Shib mot Iran. IS tok ansvar for en eksplosjon som drepte en irakisk brigader og hans assistent, og KRG avviste rapporter om ukrainske droner og personell i regionen. Iraks utenriksminister møtte presidenten for International Crisis Group for å diskutere sikkerhetsutviklingen, og 396 dødsfall i kamp ble registrert i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: The Sudanese army and the Rapid Support Forces have escalated drone attacks, striking a market in Abyei and killing more than 150 civilians. RSF fighters have deliberately targeted hospitals in El Fasher, worsening medical access. The conflict’s shift to extensive drone warfare is intensifying the humanitarian crisis and prompting renewed UN-mediated peace talks. The UN Security Council is holding a live session on the war’s spread, the impact of drones and hunger. 4,680 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

RSF-krigere har bevisst rettet angrep mot sykehus i El Fasher, noe som forverrer medisinsk tilgang. Konfliktens skifte til omfattende dronekrigføring intensiverer den humanitære krisen og fører til fornyede FN-medierte fredssamtaler. FN-sikkerhetsrådet holder en direktesendt sesjon om krigens spredning, dronenes påvirkning og sult. 4 680 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Sudanese armed forces have carried out drone strikes on markets in the disputed Abyei border region, killing more than 150 people in each attack. The strikes hit civilian gatherings, including mourners and a fuel market, causing hundreds of casualties. Communal clashes continue, with killings reported between Warrap and Lakes communities and arrests related to youth violence in Juba. Fresh attacks in Ruweng left nine dead and six wounded, and bodies arrived from the Khor Kaltan killings in Northern Bahr el Ghazal. The UCDP recorded two battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
approved.nb: Den sudanske hæren har gjennomført droneangrep på markeder i den omstridte grenseområdet Abyei, og drept mer enn 150 personer i hvert angrep. Angrepene rammet sivile samlinger, inkludert sørgende og et drivstoffmarked, og forårsaket hundrevis av skadde. Kommunale sammenstøt fortsetter, med drap rapportert mellom Warrap- og Lakes-samfunnene og arrestasjoner knyttet til ungdomsvold i Juba. Nye angrep i Ruweng etterlot ni døde og seks sårede, og lik ankom fra drapene i Khor Kaltan i Nord-Bahr el Ghazal. UCDP registrerte to dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Ethiopian forces have installed a caretaker administration in Tigray and are moving toward the Eritrean border, while a pro-government militia says it seized the regional airport and reports Eritrean forces suffered losses there. The United States, through Secretary of State Marco Rubio, is urging Ethiopia and Eritrea to de-escalate, and Mekelle mayor Shishay Amare announced elections within six months to settle Western Tigray through constitutional processes. A drone strike in the disputed Abyei region killed at least 73 people, and the TPLF claims to have killed 1,511 Ethiopian soldiers in recent fighting. The conflict caused 2,824 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

USA, gjennom utenriksminister Marco Rubio, oppfordrer Etiopia og Eritrea til å de-eskalere, og Mekelle-borgermester Shishay Amare kunngjorde valg innen seks måneder for å løse Vest-Tigray gjennom konstitusjonelle prosesser. Et droneangrep i det omstridte Abyei-området drepte minst 73 personer, og TPLF hevder å ha drept 1 511 etiopiske soldater i nylige kamper. Konflikten forårsaket 2 824 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Fitgharan forces now hold the Mogadishu-Baidoa corridor while Laftagareen forces have taken Buurhakaba and another town in the Bay region, expanding fighting in southern Somalia. Al Shabaab detonated an IED in Mandera, injuring six civilians, and the ICRC treated 148 wounded after heavy combat in Baidoa. Ethiopia has withdrawn more than 3,000 troops from Somalia as its own civil war intensifies and will not intervene in the South West State conflict. The UAE carried out a drone strike in Puntland that killed four family members, including a pregnant teenager, and the US and UAE launched airstrikes against al-Shabaab in northern Somalia. 2,284 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Al Shabaab detonerte en IED i Mandera, og seks sivile ble skadet, og Røde Kors behandlet 148 sårede etter tung kamp i Baidoa. Etiopia har trukket tilbake mer enn 3 000 soldater fra Somalia etter hvert som den egen borgerkrigen intensiveres, og vil ikke gripe inn i konflikten i South West State. De forente arabiske emirater gjennomførte et droneangrep i Puntland som drepte fire familiemedlemmer, inkludert en gravid tenåring, og USA og De forente arabiske emirater gjennomførte luftangrep mot al-Shabaab i nordlige Somalia. 2 284 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

In northern Niger gunmen attacked buses, killing at least 12 people. In Mali Islamic State militants killed at least 48 civilians in Ménaka and separate gunmen attacks killed over 40 civilians, and a court in Mopti tried 69 soldiers for alleged crimes. The conflict produced 4,159 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

I Mali drepte IS-militante minst 48 sivile i Ménaka, og separate angrep fra væpnede menn drepte over 40 sivile, og en domstol i Mopti prøvde 69 soldater for påståtte forbrytelser. approved.en: Ebola has reached an eighth province in eastern DRC, prompting alerts in Lubumbashi and border closures by Kenya and Uganda after 12 truck drivers were killed. The ADF continues attacks in Ituri while the FRN operates near Lubumbashi, and both UPDF and FARDC are conducting joint operations against ADF commanders in the region. A mercenary force suffered combat casualties in the Congo, and rebel-linked violence has led to civilian deaths. The conflict produced 1,158 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
